Variant allele frequency track

Source: R/geom-vaf-landscape.R
geom_vaf_landscape.Rd

Draws each mutation as a point at its position and variant allele frequency (VAF), colored by the local density of points so clusters of mutations at similar VAF stand out. x and y default to the start and VAF columns. Density is estimated from the mutations within the coord_locus() window.

Also adds a "Density" color scale labeled from low to high, a y-axis fixed to 0-1, and a "VAF" y-axis title. Add your own scales or labs() after it to override them.

Usage

geom_vaf_landscape(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  point_size = 3,
  background = "gray50",
  method = "kde2d",
  adjust = 1,
  show_first_y_label = TRUE,
  ...,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mapping

Set of aesthetic mappings created by ggplot2::aes().

data

GRanges object or data frame of mutations with seqnames, start, and VAF columns, e.g. a MAF with VAF = t_alt_count / t_depth.

point_size

Size of the points in mm, default: 3

background

Fill color of the panel behind the points, default: "gray50", which gives the light end of the density colors contrast. Use NA for none.

method, adjust

Density estimation method and bandwidth adjustment, see ggpointdensity::stat_pointdensity(). Default: "kde2d", 1

show_first_y_label

Label the lowest y-axis break, default: TRUE. See label_drop_first().

...

Other arguments passed to ggpointdensity::stat_pointdensity(), e.g. alpha or shape.

na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

See ggplot2::layer().

Value

List of ggplot2 layers, scales, and a y-axis title, added to a plot with +

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
snvs$VAF <- snvs$t_alt_count / snvs$t_depth

ggplot2::ggplot(snvs) +
  geom_vaf_landscape() +
  coord_locus("chr1:203296001-203313000") +
  theme_genomic()
} # }
